name: Redirection Manager PTI
author: PTI WebTech

sections.description:
Redirection Manager PTI makes managing redirects effortless and intelligent. From SEO enhancements to WooCommerce support, Redirection Manager PTI gives you full control over redirections and 404s — all in a beautifully designed admin UI.

🚀 Features:

  • ✅ Manual 301/302 redirects with expiry support
  • 🔄 Auto-redirect on post/page/product slug change
  • 📦 WooCommerce smart redirect suggestions for missing products
  • ❌ 404 logging with hit count and last accessed time
  • 💡 Suggested redirects from 404 logs
  • 🔍 Search, sort, and manage redirects easily
  • 📆 Optional redirect expiry dates
  • 📈 Hit tracking for each redirect
  • 🧠 Automatic redirect insertion for renamed content
  • ⚙️ Optimized for SEO and performance
  • 🌐 Compatible with all post types and custom post types
  • 🎨 Professional, clean admin panel
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/redirection-manager-pti directory or install it directly from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Tools > Redirection Manager or look for Redirection Manager in your admin menu.
  4. Start managing redirects and reviewing suggestions.
sections.faq:
Does Redirection Manager PTI support 301 and 302 redirects?

Yes! You can choose the redirect type when adding a new rule.

What happens if I change a product or page slug?

Redirection Manager PTI will detect slug changes and automatically add a redirect from the old URL to the new one.

Does this plugin work with WooCommerce?

Absolutely. It suggests smart product redirects based on user search and 404 detection.

Can I manage 404 logs?

Yes. Redirection Manager PTI logs 404 hits and allows you to create redirects from them or delete the logs.
